def calculate_minimum_toll(K: int, Sx: int, Sy: int, Tx: int, Ty: int) -> int:
    # Adjust coordinates to simplify calculations
    Sx += K
    Sy += K
    Tx += K
    Ty += K

    # Initial upper bound for the distance
    dist = abs(Tx - Sx) + abs(Ty - Sy)

    # Consider large tiles if K > 1
    if K > 1:
        large_start = []
        if ((Sx // K) ^ (Sy // K)) & 1:  # Start is on a large tile
            large_start.append((Sx // K, Sy // K, 0))
        else:  # Find nearest large tile
            large_start.append((Sx // K - 1, Sy // K, 1 + Sx % K))
            large_start.append((Sx // K + 1, Sy // K, K - Sx % K))
            large_start.append((Sx // K, Sy // K - 1, 1 + Sy % K))
            large_start.append((Sx // K, Sy // K + 1, K - Sy % K))

        large_goal = []
        if ((Tx // K) ^ (Ty // K)) & 1:  # End is on a large tile
            large_goal.append((Tx // K, Ty // K, 0))
        else:  # Find nearest large tile
            large_goal.append((Tx // K - 1, Ty // K, 1 + Tx % K))
            large_goal.append((Tx // K + 1, Ty // K, K - Tx % K))
            large_goal.append((Tx // K, Ty // K - 1, 1 + Ty % K))
            large_goal.append((Tx // K, Ty // K + 1, K - Ty % K))

        for x, y, d1 in large_start:
            for z, w, d2 in large_goal:
                x_diff = abs(x - z)
                y_diff = abs(y - w)
                if K == 2:
                    dist = min(dist, d1 + d2 + x_diff + y_diff + (max(x_diff, y_diff) - min(x_diff, y_diff)) // 2)
                else:
                    dist = min(dist, d1 + d2 + x_diff + y_diff)

    return dist
